milestone: Fase 1-D — limite do cache de metadata da tela de detalhes no Desktop

change.implementation: Synchronous thread-safe LRU preserves load and peek call sites and guards concurrent fetch callers. A cache entry retains its base metadata and optional settings-fingerprinted enriched metadata. Eviction leaves active UI state intact; a later miss uses the existing fetch path.

androidHostTest.failure: compileAndroidMain reports unresolved PointerButton/button/onPointerEvent in MainAppContent.kt, HomePosterHoverPreview.kt, and PlayerScreenContent.kt.
androidHostTest.baseline: All three files are unchanged from the PR base branch.

limitations: The Android host test did not run because the unchanged baseline branch fails to compile pointer-event APIs in three common source files.
iOS targets were disabled by the Windows host.
The MSI is an alpha-labelled local validation artifact and is not a stable release; it was not published.
Entry-count limits are not exact heap-byte budgets, and no physical-PC heap/jank measurement or QA was performed.
Stable release v1.0.13 is unchanged. Login and authentication were not changed; the app continues to use the Nuvio login flow.
